chunks: Abu Muhammad, the brother of ʿAli ibn Muhammad al-Farisi, whose mention has preceded.

key_terms.أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ: A teknonym identifying the person being referenced.
key_terms.ذِكْرُهُ: His mention; referring to an earlier reference in the text.
key_terms.عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ: The named individual to whom Abu Muhammad is related.

ai.seo_question: Who is Abu Muhammad in relation to ʿAli ibn Muhammad al-Farisi?
ai.summary: This text is a brief biographical identification of a person named Abu Muhammad. It clarifies his relation to ʿAli ibn Muhammad al-Farisi by stating that he is his brother and that the latter was mentioned earlier.
